title: Anchor does not change on rerun()
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

`st.subheader()` generates an HTML anchor, but that anchor does not change on a re-run, even if the argument to subheader() changes.

### Reproducible Code Example

[![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-8793)

```Python
import streamlit as st
import datetime

st.subheader(f"Time: {datetime.datetime.now()}")
if st.button("🔄 Refresh UI"):
    st.rerun()
```


### Steps To Reproduce

1. Run the above code.
2. Hover the mouse over the chain links to see the URL containing a fragment corresponding to the current time.
3. Click the refresh button
4. Hover over the chain link again, and notice the fragment does not change.

### Expected Behavior

The fragment should match the displayed subheading.

For me, I was displaying an error message specific to my app.  I did a rerun() and when the page refreshed my app had cleared the error, but the hover help and href link confused my users.

### Current Behavior

The hover help correctly changes in a multi-page app when I change pages.
In a single page app, or if I rerun() within a page, the href does not match the current subheading.

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: version 1.34.0
- Python version: Python 3.11.4
- Operating System: Mac 14.5
- Browser: Chrome, Firefox, Safari (hard to see on Safari, as hover link display disabled by default).


### Additional Information

_No response_
